datasets.name: kpi_recovery_status
queryLines:
WITH pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_current_ratio
      END
    ) AS pre_current_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_current_ratio
      END
    ) AS covid_current_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_current_ratio
      END
    ) AS post_current_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_debt_ratio
      END
    ) AS pre_debt_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_debt_ratio
      END
    ) AS covid_debt_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_debt_ratio
      END
    ) AS post_debt_ratio,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_roa
      END
    ) AS pre_roa,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_roa
      END
    ) AS covid_roa,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_roa
      END
    ) AS post_roa,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_roe
      END
    ) AS pre_roe,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_roe
      END
    ) AS covid_roe,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_roe
      END
    ) AS post_roe,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_operating_margin
      END
    ) AS pre_op_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_operating_margin
      END
    ) AS covid_op_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_operating_margin
      END
    ) AS post_op_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_gross_margin
      END
    ) AS pre_gross_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_gross_margin
      END
    ) AS covid_gross_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_gross_margin
      END
    ) AS post_gross_margin,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_asset_turnover
      END
    ) AS pre_asset_turnover,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_asset_turnover
      END
    ) AS covid_asset_turnover,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_asset_turnover
      END
    ) AS post_asset_turnover,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Pre-COVID' THEN avg_debt_to_equity
      END
    ) AS pre_debt_equity,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'COVID-Impact' THEN avg_debt_to_equity
      END
    ) AS covid_debt_equity,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'Post-COVID-Recovery' THEN avg_debt_to_equity
      END
    ) AS post_debt_equity
  FROM
    dbacademy.default.sec_edgar_analysis_3
)
SELECT
  'Current ratio' AS kpi,
  pre_current_ratio AS pre_covid,
  covid_current_ratio AS covid_impact,
  post_current_ratio AS post_covid,
  CASE
    WHEN post_current_ratio > pre_current_ratio * 1.1 THEN 'Recovered'
    ELSE 'Recovering'
  END AS status
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Debt ratio',
  pre_debt_ratio,
  covid_debt_ratio,
  post_debt_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN post_debt_ratio < pre_debt_ratio * 0.9 THEN 'Recovered'
    ELSE 'Recovering'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'ROA',
  pre_roa,
  covid_roa,
  post_roa,
  CASE
    WHEN post_roa > pre_roa THEN 'Recovering'
    ELSE 'Not fully recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'ROE',
  pre_roe,
  covid_roe,
  post_roe,
  CASE
    WHEN post_roe < pre_roe THEN 'Below baseline'
    ELSE 'Recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Operating margin',
  pre_op_margin,
  covid_op_margin,
  post_op_margin,
  CASE
    WHEN post_op_margin < pre_op_margin THEN 'Not recovered'
    ELSE 'Recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Gross margin',
  pre_gross_margin,
  covid_gross_margin,
  post_gross_margin,
  CASE
    WHEN post_gross_margin < pre_gross_margin THEN 'Slight decline'
    ELSE 'Recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Asset turnover',
  pre_asset_turnover,
  covid_asset_turnover,
  post_asset_turnover,
  CASE
    WHEN post_asset_turnover < pre_asset_turnover THEN 'Declining'
    ELSE 'Recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Debt to equity',
  pre_debt_equity,
  covid_debt_equity,
  post_debt_equity,
  CASE
    WHEN post_debt_equity > pre_debt_equity * 1.05 THEN 'Partial recovery'
    ELSE 'Recovered'
  END
FROM
  pivoted

datasets.name: fastest_recovering_sectors
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE sic
    WHEN 5900 THEN 'Retail stores'
    WHEN 8082 THEN 'Home health'
    WHEN 3826 THEN 'Lab instruments'
    WHEN 4700 THEN 'Transportation'
    WHEN 3842 THEN 'Ortho equip'
    WHEN 7380 THEN 'Business svcs'
    WHEN 1000 THEN 'Metal mining'
    WHEN 4011 THEN 'Railroads'
    WHEN 2835 THEN 'Diagnostics'
    WHEN 6798 THEN 'REITs'
    ELSE CAST(sic AS STRING)
  END AS sector_name,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(sic AS STRING),
    ' ',
    CASE sic
      WHEN 5900 THEN 'Retail stores'
      WHEN 8082 THEN 'Home health'
      WHEN 3826 THEN 'Lab instruments'
      WHEN 4700 THEN 'Transportation'
      WHEN 3842 THEN 'Ortho equip'
      WHEN 7380 THEN 'Business svcs'
      WHEN 1000 THEN 'Metal mining'
      WHEN 4011 THEN 'Railroads'
      WHEN 2835 THEN 'Diagnostics'
      WHEN 6798 THEN 'REITs'
      ELSE CAST(sic AS STRING)
    END
  ) AS sector_label,
  roa_delta
FROM
  dbacademy.default.sec_edgar_analysis_4
ORDER BY
  roa_delta DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: most_impacted_sectors
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE sic
    WHEN 5810 THEN 'Eating/drinking'
    WHEN 8741 THEN 'Consulting'
    WHEN 2030 THEN 'Food processing'
    WHEN 6794 THEN 'Patents'
    WHEN 3829 THEN 'Instruments'
    WHEN 4899 THEN 'Communications'
    WHEN 3670 THEN 'Electronics'
    WHEN 6531 THEN 'Real estate'
    WHEN 1700 THEN 'Construction'
    WHEN 3663 THEN 'Radio/TV equip'
    ELSE CAST(sic AS STRING)
  END AS sector_name,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(sic AS STRING),
    ' ',
    CASE sic
      WHEN 5810 THEN 'Eating/drinking'
      WHEN 8741 THEN 'Consulting'
      WHEN 2030 THEN 'Food processing'
      WHEN 6794 THEN 'Patents'
      WHEN 3829 THEN 'Instruments'
      WHEN 4899 THEN 'Communications'
      WHEN 3670 THEN 'Electronics'
      WHEN 6531 THEN 'Real estate'
      WHEN 1700 THEN 'Construction'
      WHEN 3663 THEN 'Radio/TV equip'
      ELSE CAST(sic AS STRING)
    END
  ) AS sector_label,
  roa_delta,
  companies
FROM
  dbacademy.default.sec_edgar_analysis_2
ORDER BY
  roa_delta ASC
LIMIT 10

dimensions.name: quarter_label
dimensions.expr: CONCAT(CAST(source_year AS STRING), 'Q', CAST(source_quarter AS STRING))

lines: > SIC 5810 (Eating & Drinking) worst hit at -0.54 ROA delta. Food processing and consulting also severely impacted.
> SIC 5900 (Retail) showed strongest recovery at +0.52. Healthcare-adjacent and transportation sectors also recovered strongly.

frame.title: DEBT RATIO & CURRENT RATIO — 28 QUARTER TREND (2018–2024)

lines: > Debt ratio declined from 0.87 to 0.59 by 2022. Current ratio surged Post-COVID peaking at 4.14 in Q1 2022. Both normalizing in 2024 — signaling a new leverage cycle beginning.

frame.title: ROA & Op Margin Change by Class

lines: > Most companies are Improving or Stable, with Deteriorating firms showing negative ROA and margin change. Group averages: Improving (+0.21 ROA, +0.15 Op Margin), Stable (0.00 ROA, +0.01 Op Margin), Deteriorating (-0.16 ROA, -0.09 Op Margin).
